assets.name: Медная монета
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: compact DnD Share fantasy currency icon, later downsampled to a transparent 128x128 WebP and displayed at 20–64 pixels.
Style/medium: polished flat-cartoon game inventory art, thick continuous deep-plum contours, broad clean shapes, restrained two-step cel shading, a clear broad upper-left highlight. Crisp professional game asset. One large stamped geometric emblem readable at 20 pixels.
Composition/framing: ONE isolated coin centered on a square canvas, occupying 84% of the canvas with even padding. Almost frontal view with just a narrow visible lower-right thickness/beveled edge. Complete silhouette. No surrounding objects. No separate sparkles. Strong contrast between metal face and stamped emblem.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background. No backdrop, tile, decorative frame outside the coin, floor, cast shadow, scene, hands, character, lettering, numerals, words, logo, watermark, photorealism, grain, tiny filigree or micro-detail. Keep the symbol bold and simple, not a tiny engraving.
Subject: One round warm copper coin, burnt orange and russet metal, a thick raised rim and one large square punched center hole. The hole is visibly dark; thick highlighted inner lip. Broad copper face around the hole. Rounded, substantial silhouette.
